source_page_metadata.description: Explore the Querkle marijuana strain - THC levels, genetics, terpene profile, effects, flavor, and grow tips.

article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Indica-Dominant Hybrid
Genetics: Purple Urkle × Space Queen
Breeder: Subcool’s The Dank
THC Content: 18–24%
CBD Content: Low (typically under 1%)
Terpene Profile: Myrcene , Caryophyllene , Linalool
Primary Flavors: Grape, Berry, Sweet, Earthy
Flowering Time (Indoor): 8–9 weeks
Outdoor Harvest Time: Early October
Indoor Yield: 14–18 oz per m²
Outdoor Yield: 16–20 oz per plant
Grow Difficulty: Moderate

Querkle is a cultivar that emerged during the early era of boutique cannabis breeding, when breeders began experimenting with bold flavor combinations and striking visual traits. Created by the late Subcool of TGA Genetics, the strain combines the deeply colored indica Purple Urkle with the vibrant, terpene-rich hybrid Space Queen. The result is a plant that blends rich grape-like aromas with uplifting undertones, producing a hybrid experience that feels both relaxing and expressive.

From the moment its dense buds are revealed, the strain often showcases vibrant purple hues that reflect its Urkle heritage. Paired with a complex terpene profile and balanced psychoactive effects, this hybrid quickly earned a place among connoisseur cultivars valued for both aesthetic appeal and flavor depth. Over time, it has remained a favorite among enthusiasts who appreciate classic purple genetics with a modern twist.
Genetics and Lineage

The lineage behind Querkle reflects the creative breeding philosophy of TGA Genetics, which focused on pairing flavorful strains with strong visual characteristics. One of the parent plants, Purple Urkle, is a legendary California indica known for its deep purple coloration and unmistakable grape aroma. Believed to descend from Mendocino Purps or similar Northern California genetics, Purple Urkle contributes heavy body relaxation and rich fruit-forward terpene expression.

The second parent, Space Queen, adds a completely different dimension to the hybrid. Developed from Romulan crossed with Cinderella 99 , Space Queen carries strong sativa influence and vibrant terpene expression. This lineage introduces brighter citrus notes, energetic cerebral effects, and increased resin production.

When combined, these two contrasting genetic lines produce a hybrid that balances relaxation with mental stimulation. Purple Urkle contributes calming body effects and vivid coloration, while Space Queen introduces uplifting cerebral energy and aromatic complexity. The resulting cultivar embodies a careful equilibrium between two distinct cannabis families.

Through selective breeding and phenotype selection, Subcool stabilized plants that consistently expressed strong flavor, vivid color, and balanced potency. The resulting hybrid quickly gained recognition among cannabis enthusiasts for its unique blend of sensory qualities.
Effects and Experience

The experience produced by Querkle often begins with a gentle shift in mood accompanied by subtle mental uplift. Shortly after consumption, many individuals notice a mild wave of euphoria that enhances sensory awareness and encourages a relaxed mental state.

As the experience continues to develop, the strain’s physical effects gradually emerge. A soothing body relaxation begins to spread through the limbs, easing muscular tension and encouraging physical comfort. Despite these relaxing qualities, the mind often remains pleasantly engaged rather than fully sedated.

Over time, the hybrid’s effects tend to settle into a tranquil balance between mental ease and physical calm. The initial mental brightness softens while the body maintains a steady sense of relaxation. For many consumers, this progression makes the strain well suited for evening use or creative downtime when relaxation and mental clarity are both desirable.
Medical Benefits

Patients exploring cannabis for therapeutic support often appreciate the balanced effect profile of Querkle. The calming body sensations associated with the strain may help relieve muscular tension and minor physical discomfort. Because the relaxation develops gradually, the experience often feels smooth rather than overwhelming.

The mild euphoric qualities of the strain may also support emotional well-being. Individuals dealing with stress or mental fatigue sometimes find that the hybrid encourages a more relaxed perspective while maintaining mental clarity.

In addition, the relaxing properties of the plant may help prepare the body for sleep . As the experience deepens, the soothing physical sensations can make it easier to unwind at the end of the day. For individuals seeking nighttime relaxation without immediate sedation, the strain may offer a comfortable transition into rest.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

The terpene profile of Querkle creates a distinctive sensory experience centered around fruit-forward sweetness. When the dried flower is handled, a rich grape aroma often emerges, reflecting the strong influence of Purple Urkle within the genetic lineage.

Myrcene contributes earthy depth to the aroma, while limonene introduces bright citrus notes that enhance the fruit character. Caryophyllene adds a subtle peppery warmth that rounds out the fragrance and prevents it from becoming overly sweet.

During consumption, the flavor often mirrors the aromatic complexity. The inhale typically delivers sweet grape and berry notes accompanied by faint herbal undertones. As the vapor or smoke settles on the palate, subtle citrus brightness and mild spice become more noticeable, creating a smooth and layered flavor experience.
Growing Information

Growing this hybrid generally presents a manageable challenge for growers. The plant typically develops a short-to-medium height with broad leaves and thick branches characteristic of indica genetics . This compact structure makes it particularly suitable for indoor growing environments with limited vertical space.

Indoor flowering cycles usually complete within eight to nine weeks. During this stage, the plant produces dense buds that often display vibrant purple hues when exposed to cooler nighttime temperatures. The flowers are typically coated in resinous trichomes that contribute to both potency and visual appeal.

Outdoor cultivation can produce excellent results in temperate climates with consistent sunlight. When grown outdoors, the plant may develop slightly larger structures while maintaining its compact bud formation. Maintaining proper airflow and humidity levels helps ensure healthy flower development throughout the flowering phase.
FAQ
What kind of strain is Querkle? Querkle is an indica-dominant hybrid created by crossing Purple Urkle with Space Queen.
How strong is Querkle? THC levels typically range between 18% and 24%, offering moderate to strong potency depending on the phenotype.
What does Querkle taste like? The flavor commonly includes sweet grape notes, berry undertones, subtle citrus brightness, and mild herbal spice.
Is Querkle good for nighttime use? Many consumers prefer it in the evening because its relaxing body effects help promote calmness and unwinding.
Is Querkle easy to grow? The plant is generally considered moderately easy to cultivate thanks to its compact structure and relatively short flowering time.
Final Thoughts on Querkle

Querkle remains one of the most memorable hybrids produced during the early wave of boutique cannabis breeding. By combining the deep purple hues and grape aroma of Purple Urkle with the energetic terpene profile of Space Queen, TGA Genetics created a cultivar that offers both visual beauty and aromatic complexity.

The strain’s balanced effects allow it to appeal to a wide range of cannabis enthusiasts. Its gentle mental uplift and relaxing body sensations create a comfortable experience that encourages creativity and relaxation without overwhelming sedation. For those interested in classic purple genetics with an added layer of citrus brightness and terpene depth, Querkle continues to stand as a distinctive and respected cultivar within modern cannabis breeding .
